key_insight: SCoRE improves visual RAG by explicitly selecting, preserving, and then consolidating only the most relevant page images before answer generation, instead of relying on noisy exploratory trajectories.
engineering_relevance: This design is useful for building more reliable document AI systems because it keeps visual context bounded while maintaining traceable image-backed reasoning.
method: Maintain a textual ledger of query-relevant observations plus source pointers during exploration.
Reload the referenced original images at the end and consolidate them into a logical evidence sequence.
Train with filtered cold-start trajectory distillation and evidence-aware reinforcement learning to optimize coverage, compactness, and correctness.
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates an end-to-end training and evaluation setup using evidence-aware rewards that jointly promote evidence coverage, consolidation compactness, and answer correctness.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate source-pointer tracking and reliable image reloading, so pointer errors or poor evidence selection could weaken grounding and final answers.
paper_title: Navigating Sparse Evidence: Agentic Visual RAG via Explicit Context Selection and Consolidation
